bio: Jonathan Huang First-Year Social Committee Ivy Yard Hey Class of 2026! My name is Jonathan Huang and I’m from Houston, Texas! This year, I’m residing in Massachusetts Hall and Ivy Yard. I joined FYSC since I love planning events and want to create a welcoming environment for our class! In my free time, you can find me either exploring downtown Boston or doing something Apple related. I look forward to working alongside the rest of this amazing team to make our first year extra memorable!
